turns.user: ok so a few things, I'm starving today so I think I need more carbs, what should I have before training tomorrow morning, and is it fine that I skipped the stretching at the end yesterday
turns.reply:
If you’re starving, add a solid portion of oats to your next meal to top up your muscle glycogen for tomorrow's lift, though rice or potatoes work great too.

For tomorrow morning, a banana with toast 30–60 minutes out digests fast so it won't sit heavy, but oats are another good option.

Skipping yesterday's stretching is totally fine because missing it won't wreck your recovery, even if it feels nice to wind down.
